Companion Animal Travel Desk Processing Rules

Purpose: This section sets the booking, fee, and recordkeeping rules for companion animal travel handled by Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk manages companion animal acceptance for travel between skyports and must apply one clear standard at every transaction. Staff shall verify the passenger record, confirm the animal type, and check that the booking contains the correct service entry before any acceptance is issued. <<FACT F060>> The desk will not promise carriage until the required entry is present and the passenger has been advised of the conditions that apply to the journey.

When a traveler presents an animal for transport, the desk staff shall review the itinerary, the cabin or hold arrangement, and any service changes that affect the booking. The ledger shall be updated at once whenever the accepted arrangement changes, and the note shall be written in plain language so the welcome team can prepare the passenger correctly. If a passenger arrives with incomplete details, staff shall pause the process and resolve the matter before boarding support begins. This prevents delay at the gate and keeps companion animal handling in line with company service standards.

Staff shall maintain consistent handling across all cases. A companion animal may be accepted only after the travel desk has completed the record check and confirmed that the booking remains in good standing. Any adjustment to the service entry shall be entered without delay, and the passenger file shall show the final arrangement before the welcome team takes over. Where the trip includes more than one stop, staff shall confirm that the same entry governs the full itinerary unless a new service action is recorded. No verbal assurance shall replace the written record in the ledger.

The desk shall also manage traveler communication with care. If Liam Ali, Grace Kim, or any other passenger requests a change, staff shall use the approved booking channel and then record the result in the ledger in the same work cycle. If a pet such as Ruby is involved, the handling record shall remain clear, accurate, and current so the boarding sequence can proceed without confusion. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for clarity, and every note shall support dependable companion travel across Aurelia Skyways operations.

For any unresolved service issue, contact the senior coordinator through the normal desk channel.
